description: This file manages live session model switching, including resolving model selections, requesting switches, consuming switch states, comparing current and persisted models, and clearing pending switch flags. It interacts with session store files and embedded runner functions.

methods.name: resolveLiveSessionModelSelection
methods.description: Resolves the live session model selection based on session store, default provider/model, and overrides.

methods.name: requestLiveSessionModelSwitch
methods.description: Requests a live session model switch by aborting current embedded run and initiating a new switch.

methods.name: consumeLiveSessionModelSwitch
methods.description: Consumes the embedded run model switch state for a given session ID.

methods.name: hasDifferentLiveSessionModelSelection
methods.description: Checks if the current model selection differs from a new one.

methods.name: shouldTrackPersistedLiveSessionModelSelection
methods.description: Determines if the persisted model selection should be tracked based on current state.

methods.name: shouldSwitchToLiveModel
methods.description: Determines if a user-initiated live model switch is pending and should be applied.

methods.name: clearLiveModelSwitchPending
methods.description: Clears the pending switch flag from the session store.
